Saryu Flood Guard is an interactive app that uses NASA-ISRO NISAR radar data to track how Saryu river and Ayodhya land is changing.

On 26 Oct 2026, flood water entered houses in Nandupur  village, Ayodhya. Every year Saryu river changes its path, but villagers get no warning.

Our solution shows: 1) River Change Map - how Saryu path moved, 2) Flood Area Map - where water spread in Haraiya, 3) Danger Meter - Green = Safe, Yellow = Water Rising, Red = Flood in 2 Days, 4) Safe Shelter Map - Haraiya School and Panchayat Bhavan, 5) Voice Alert in Hindi / Awadhi.

NISAR radar can see through clouds and at night, so even during monsoon we can track flood when normal satellite fails. This helps farmers, villagers and administration to plan early and save life and crops.
details:
WHAT IS SARYU FLOOD GUARD?

Saryu Flood Guard is a web app that uses NASA-ISRO NISAR SAR radar data to track Saryu river change and give early flood warning to villagers in Bikapur, Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh.

THE PROBLEM:

On 26 Oct 2026, flood water entered houses in Bikapur village, Ayodhya. Every year Saryu river changes its path and cuts fertile land. Villagers, farmers get no early warning. Normal optical satellites fail in monsoon because of clouds.

HOW IT WORKS:

1. River Change Map: We compare NISAR SAR images from different dates to show how Saryu river path moved.

2. Flood Area Mapping: We mark where water spread in Bikapur during flood.

3. Danger Meter: Green = Safe, Yellow = Water Rising - Be Ready, Red = Flood in 2 Days - Move to Safe Place.

4. Safe Shelter Map: Shows Bikapur School and Panchayat Bhavan as safe shelters with route.

5. Voice Alert: Alert in Hindi and Awadhi language so every villager can understand.

WHY NISAR SAR?

NISAR radar can see through clouds and at night. So even in heavy rain and monsoon, we can track flood when normal satellite photos are white with clouds. SAR also shows water very clearly because water looks dark in radar image.

TOOLS USED:

HTML, CSS, JavaScript, GitHub Pages for website, NISAR SAR data concept, Google Slides and YouTube for demo video.

BENEFITS AND IMPACT:

- Farmers can save crops and animals by moving early.

- Families can shift important things and documents to safe place.

- Administration and Gram Pradhan can plan rescue and food help early.

- Low cost solution, works on normal mobile phone, no costly app needed.

CREATIVITY:

We made a local problem into a space solution. We used Danger Meter like traffic light so even a person who cannot read English can understand. We added Awadhi voice idea because villagers speak Awadhi, not English.

FUTURE PLAN:

We want to add live water level from river gauge, SMS alert without internet, and cover full Saryu river from Gonda to Ayodhya to Mau.
